name: m3_CharCall14ED520
notes: Find the character type for a kind in the type table (first kind 2, negative ends it) and call its +0x14 handler

name: m3_CharCall1CED590
notes: Same type lookup, calls the +0x1C handler

name: m3_CharPathEE080
notes: Walk the type table (result unused), then format host0:data/char/%s into the buffer; do-while with a volatile walk pointer keeps the loop

name: m3_FxAttachF4280
notes: Play effect 0x3B2 at the object position, then attach it in mode 3 or 4; volatile store in each branch keeps both calls

name: m3_BroadcastE4050
notes: Send three values to every node of a target set (kind 1 player, kind 3 a group of 0x150-byte lists, else a record lookup); goto keeps the single lookup call

name: m3_AiSpin138270
notes: AI state entry: state from flag bits, spin rate 1.5 or 2 degrees per frame unit and its negative, flags 0x20 and 0x400000, attach mode 10

name: m3_ApplyLightEAD50
notes: Apply a light record: position with w 1 and byte colour as floats, passed with the id to 0xE43D0

name: m3_CylOverlapA2890
notes: Cylinder overlap test: horizontal distance against summed radii, then the height spans

name: m3_AnimResetC6AA0
notes: Release the attached node and reset the record fields (scale 1, speed 0.5, unit w vectors)

name: m3_ObjReleaseF42C0
notes: Release an active object: stop the stream and the camera's pending sound, detach it, mark it inactive, remove its kind 5 and 0xD components

name: m3_AiStopF15B0
notes: Stop the AI (velocity rate*0, counters cleared), touch its kind 5 component, play a cue unless game mode is 4 or 5; hangs on null

name: m3_ModeSetupAAC10
notes: Fill a 3-int setting for a mode, then set camera flag 3 from story bit 0xCA and the current event (12, 0x22)

name: m3_BoneFxC53B0
notes: Start effect 0x24 at a bone of the held model, lowered by 18 units

name: m3_ModeSetupB7EE0
notes: Mode setup for a 2-int setting; a setting of 10 syncs slot 2 with story bit 0xC0

name: m3_SpawnRandomA9340
notes: Pick a random enemy kind from a small table (0x17 becomes 3 or 4 unless 0x420090 is set) and spawn it at the origin; volatile store in one branch keeps both rand calls

name: m3_AiIdleWait138640
notes: AI idle entry: flag updates, then a random wait (1..2 for kinds 11 and 6, else 8..10 or 5..8)

name: m3_ComboTickE5B70
notes: Add to the combo counter unless locked, clamp at the maximum and fire stat 0x42 plus a stage event, then play the next of four tips when the tip timer runs out

name: m3_ApplyLight2EA930
notes: Apply a two-colour light record: byte colours as floats and the millisecond time scaled to seconds, passed to 0xE1570

name: m3_AttachPlaceC6D50
notes: Place the attached body: copy the position, build its matrix from X and Y rotation and uniform scale, translate and copy it out

name: m3_SpawnFromRecEAEE0
notes: Spawn an object from a spawn record (position and yaw), start it in its mode and store it in the owner's slot table

name: m3_PointToFrameEE3B0
notes: Transform a point record by a frame's normalised axes plus origin (or copy it without a frame), set w 1 and copy the id

name: m3_BossHomeVelCBD60
notes: Aim the boss from its target to its home point: velocity = direction * distance/30*3, acceleration = direction * -(that*0.02)

name: m3_SoulPickupA9B80
notes: Collect a soul pickup (kinds 0x18..0x1B worth 1, 10, 30, 100): mark it taken, play its sound when the cooldown allows, add the amount to the counter, stats and soul total

name: m3_ProbeDirF6510
notes: Probe from half a unit below the object towards an angle at a distance; 1 when the collision query reports a hit

name: m3_TblRestoreA9DC0
notes: Reset table settings (scales 1 and 2, selection -1, count 0) and restore ten 0x34-byte records from their saved copy

name: m3_MgrsHoldF8170
notes: Put the three stage managers into their hold state (flag updates, clear the +0xA4 counter)

name: m3_SndCmdEA2A0
notes: Run a sound command on bank A or B: restart a slot with 0 or its table value, or play it 3D at a source object; remember the mode per slot

name: m3_ArenaLightsE1170
notes: Set up the battle arena light units once: two states (hang on failure), load both light packs, allocate a kind-8 unit for each, clear eight light slots

name: m3_AiPickTarget114930
notes: Choose the AI target: locked keeps a live target or falls back to the player; otherwise a decoy within 40 units and no farther than the player, else the player; flag 0x1000 marks a change

name: m3_VoicePickEBF00
notes: Play a random voice line from a record (idle pair, hurt set or win set), counting the non-zero entries for the random pick

name: m3_TurnToA3170
notes: Turn towards a goal by at most |step| (the whole difference when smaller), wrap the yaw into -pi..pi, copy the rotation to the body
